savings.reason: Reading record LSP-EO_12292 (EO 12292, 46 FR 13967-13968, read once in full): no savings, continuation, transfer or exception provision; sec. 10(g) revokes EO 10897 whole and sec. 11 makes the revocation effective as of 1981-02-15; the recital says the order conforms existing orders to the Foreign Service Act of 1980. Own-residual check, reading EO 10897 in full: sec. 1 delegated to the Secretary of State the President's authority to prescribe rules for the Foreign Service Retirement and Disability System (maintenance, participation of certain staff, voluntary contributions), and sec. 3 let those rules take effect retroactively to 1960-10-16 or later. Rules issued under a delegation are the delegate's own acts and retirement participation and contributions made under them are accrued, so something outlives the revocation even though EO 12292 neither saves nor extinguishes it. Sec. 2 superseded EO 9941 and EO 12292 does not list EO 9941, so the revocation of EO 10897 states no revival of it. research_rationale: EO 10897 (signed December 2, 1960; 25 FR 12429; the held text file also carries EO 10898, which is not part of this order), read in full, delegates to the Secretary of State the President's rulemaking authority over the Foreign Service Retirement and Disability System under sec. 303 of the Foreign Service Act of 1946, supersedes EO 9941 (sec. 2) and takes effect as of October 16, 1960 (sec. 3). It has no term or sunset. EO 12292 (signed February 23, 1981; 46 FR 13967-13968), read in full, revokes it in sec. 10(g) and makes itself 'effective as of February 15, 1981' (sec. 11), so the end date is 1981-02-15. (The dossier labels the provision 'Sec. 9.'; the printed text reads 'Sec. 10.') The dossier's six scopes cover every operative paragraph; the authority recital is not inventoried because it carries no command. Earlier-end test: the OFR catalog hits (2) and the dossier chain show only EO 12292; there are no U.S. Code or eCFR hits, and no amendment, supersession or earlier revocation was found.
